failure_modes.name: Multi_Hop_Context_Degradation
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 after hop 1 states: 'While the passages confirm the play is "Twelfth Night," they do NOT explicitly verify that "Twelfth Night" has an alternative title of "What You Will."' However, Summary_2 after hop 2 claims: 'Shakespeare's comedy play "Twelfth Night" is definitively also known by the name "What You Will" (confirmed in passages [1], [2], [3], [4], and [5], which consistently refer to it as "Twelfth Night, or What You Will")' — but hop 1's actual passages do not contain this information. Summary_2 hallucinates evidence that was not present in the retrieved passages.
